title: Pocket tickler & standup notes
content:
Quick dump for the day — use as running pocket list. Mostly TODOs and tiny notes to self.

08:00 — morning
- 08:15 standup: mention canary flakiness, ask SRE for logs retention window.
- 08:30 call with Maya to review onboarding snippet for new docs site (keep <2 min video).

Immediate TODOs (short hops)
- [ ] Follow up INF-879: confirm rollback window for canary (ask on thread and tag @alex).
- [ ] Add a short note in docs: how to pin model revisions for dedicated customers (draft bullet points).
- [ ] Run quantization perf test on small 2k sequence sample: use q8_0 preset, record p50/p95. Command to run: 
    cd ~/projects/serving-runtime && ./scripts/run_q_test.sh --model redwood-v1-small --seq 2048 --preset q8_0 --out /tmp/qtest-2026-03-15.log
- [ ] Check cost dashboard for last 7 days — investigate unexpected spike on Mar 12 (maybe runaway batch config).

Standup bullets to say:
- Canary started 3/12 — saw intermittent timeout at 120ms mark; probable batching skyline.
- Working on a simple KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start p90.
- Docs: short howto for pinning + rollback is ~50% drafted.

Personal micro-errands (non-work)
- [ ] Drop off suit at dry-cleaners (by 6pm) — reminder: bring discount card.
- [ ] Pick up prescription at WholeHealth Pharmacy.
- [ ] Order groceries: eggs, oat milk, spinach, coffee filters, bananas.

Notes to self / ideas (fragmented)
- If batching spikes p95, try: reduce max_batch_latency from 10ms -> 6ms for low-latency routes, log effect.
- Consider exposing simple "cache-warmup" POST route in runtime for deterministic tests.
- Quick snippet for docs: "Pin model: set model_version in route config and add canary_fraction to 0.0 for immediate full rollout." — verify exact config keys.

Followups / people to ping
- @alex: ask about whether Dedicated customers get extended trace retention.
- @maya: can you record the 90s onboarding clip by EOD? I can do edits after.
- SRE channel: request logs for node infra-12 for Mar 12 02:00-06:00 UTC.

One-off reminders (put in calendar)
- 2026-03-18 10:00 — sync with sales on demo metrics (prepare 3 charts: latency, cost/unit, error rate).
- 2026-03-19 — passport renewal deadline? double-check expiry date.

Random tiny utilities / snippets I end up reusing
- quick tail: tail -n 500 /var/log/serving-runtime/requests.log | grep "timeout" | less
- copy logs to local: rsync -avS deploy@infra:/var/log/serving-runtime/2026-03-12 /tmp/logs-0312

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] Move done items to a new note or mark completed in Jira where applicable.
- [ ] Ship docs draft to product for review (link to GH PR once created).

Notes-to-self meta: keep this file quick — delete or archive when it becomes a proper doc.

-- Jordan
